messages:
maria gonzalez: Starting thread: Oceanside onprem outage follow-ups. Summary: VPC peering flapped -> control-plane hung -> tenant isolation. Collating action items for the next 3 weeks. Please respond with owners and ETA.

kevin li: i'll take the connector bug patch (root cause looks like a race in peering tear-down). aiming for PR by EOD Wed.

tanvi patel: i'll own the onprem test harness — planning a tether test that simulates partial WAN loss and intermittent packet drops. ETA next Mon.

phil ward: ops: add alert for asymmetric peering routes (BGP origin mismatch) + dashboard tile. will target Fri for alert + runbook link.

amanda chen: question: can we scope a quick mitigation (auto-fallback to gw-model when peering is unhealthy) to reduce blast radius? i can draft proposal.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SRE-8421 (Oceanside peering followup). Link: https://jira.internal/SRE-8421

jonathan park: we also need a runbook update: "isolation triage checklist" + owner rotation. i'll draft and ping for review.

maria gonzalez: proposed timeline: patch -> test harness -> monitoring -> runbook. target completion 2025-02-14. realistic?

kevin li: patch PR open by Wed; will need 2 reviewers. tagging @phil @jonathan park for reviews.

phil ward: dropping a review in tomorrow. also strongly suggest adding an integration test to the dedicated CI to catch the teardown race sooner.

tanvi patel: CI job name proposed: onprem-tether-fuzz. i'll add to eng-ml dedicated CI matrix and open PR.

maria gonzalez: noted. action tracker below (please copy/paste to ticket):
```
- Owner: kevin li | Action: fix peering teardown race | ETA: 2025-01-22 | Ticket: SRE-8421-1
- Owner: tanvi patel | Action: tether test + CI | ETA: 2025-01-27 | Ticket: SRE-8421-2
- Owner: phil ward | Action: asymmetric-route alert + dashboard | ETA: 2025-01-24 | Ticket: SRE-8421-3
- Owner: jonathan park | Action: runbook + oncall rotation | ETA: 2025-02-07 | Ticket: SRE-8421-4
- Owner: amanda chen | Action: fallback policy design | ETA: 2025-02-11 | Ticket: SRE-8421-5
```

kevin li: :thumbsup: copied to PR description.

amanda chen: one more ask — include a post-deploy smoke (3x small requests) to confirm no KV cache divergence after peering flaps.

jonathan park: noted. also proposing a monthly regression alert: if similar tenant isolation pattern occurs twice in 90 days, auto-escalate to infra lead + security.

maria gonzalez: :eyes: can engineering leads commit to a quick retro on recurring pattern next week? propose 2025-01-28 10:00 PT.

phil ward: i'm in.

ops-bot: Reminder set: calendar invite sent to participants for 2025-01-28 10:00 PT.

tanvi patel: will surface metrics on the dashboard: peering flap count, reconnection time, tenant error-rate + KV divergence rate. adding to the ticket.

maria gonzalez: thanks everyone. i'll update SRE-8421 with today's notes and mark owners. if anything slips, call it out in this thread.
